helmv3.description: Subchart dependencies declared in any chart's Chart.yaml.

helm-values.description: Container images pinned in chart defaults. Scoped to the chart tree rather than a hand-kept list of files, so a chart added later is covered without a config change.

customManagers.description: helm-docs is installed from a release tarball in the lint workflow, which the github-actions manager only reads for `uses:` lines. Without this the pinned version would silently rot.

packageRules.description: Chart dependency and image bumps always need a chart version bump alongside them, which Renovate cannot do -- so no automerge here, ever. The pull request is the place that decision gets made.
prBodyNotes: :warning: **Bump the chart's own `version:` in `Chart.yaml` in this branch before merging.** Without it, chart-releaser skips the chart on `main` and this update never reaches consumers.

packageRules.description: Workflow action bumps are mechanical and touch no published artefact.
